authority.directRequirement: Treat the complete Summary as in-game copy and remove 'the simulation', 'simulating', and equivalent language.

included: plain concept cards and generated evidence copy
accessible names and visually hidden text
excluded: source identifiers, type names, and internal code
global application surfaces not rendered by NightDebrief
scope.lexicalRule: The rendered NightDebrief surface must contain zero case-insensitive matches for \bsimulat\w* and no player-facing game, engine, model, generated-output, or score-report frame; the bounded phrase 'does not score real people' remains required safety language.

baselineAudit.centralFinding: The natural story paragraphs are already free of simulat* in a broad probe, but the complete NightDebrief breaks immersion in its always-visible boundary, receipt introduction, status key, accessible label, and path-dependent concept evidence.

dynamicProbe.claimBoundary: This probe is pre-implementation diagnostic evidence, not exhaustive verification. The required post-correction sweep remains seeds 0 through 95 and 4294967295 under both policies plus recovery and malformed-state boundaries.

observedOutsideFrames.copy: CHORUS is a fictional simulation. It does not diagnose, predict, assess, measure, or score real people or the player.
Model limit / Its numbers and authored motives belong only to this generated night.
The simulation recorded a related effect without a matching selected action.
These labels describe the simulation record, not your beliefs, motives, or character.
Before or after a choice, the simulation recorded more checking or source support.
The simulation recorded trust from one room affecting reception in another.

existingTestConflict.observation: The review-separation contract explicitly requires the sentence 'These labels describe the simulation record...'; the model-limit contract also accepts a fictional simulation.
existingTestConflict.disposition: Historical evidence only. Replace the presentation expectation, preserve the fiction and non-diagnosis propositions, and add whole-surface negative lexical tests.

findings.title: The completed-night surface repeatedly names itself from outside the house
findings.issue: Always-visible copy and some generated evidence use simulat* even though the Summary is in-game copy.
findings.requiredCorrection: Use the night, room, record, named seats, or CHORUS as fiction; verify zero case-insensitive simulat* across the entire rendered surface.

findings.title: The boundary still uses model and generated-output frames
findings.issue: The accessible label says 'Model limit' and the notice says 'generated night'; 'does not score real people' is retained as bounded safety language.
findings.requiredCorrection: Retain the fiction and claim-limit propositions without game, engine, model, generated-output, or score-report framing.

findings.title: The status presentation conflicts with the new in-world example
findings.issue: The current labels are Selected action, Recorded effect, and Seen in scene; the new source requires Played, Experienced, and Encountered with immediate plain glosses.
findings.requiredCorrection: Supersede only the presentation clause of CHR-DEBRIEF-UND-006 while preserving typed statuses, strongest-status ordering, and evidence provenance.

findings.title: The heading can imply broader coverage than the narrative builder supplies
findings.issue: 'What changed across the night' sounds exhaustive while the builder intentionally follows one governing route, all selected last resorts, and one residue.
findings.requiredCorrection: Name the bounded subject actually narrated and keep the scene before the interpretation.

findings.title: The current close records residue without completing the new proof boundary
findings.issue: The story closes on later resolution and afterimage, while the new example also names what the movement cannot prove.
findings.requiredCorrection: Bind the proof limit to the source-backed residue without replacing it with a generic disclaimer, lesson, or moral.

findings.title: Selected action language remains vulnerable to completed-effect substitution
findings.issue: A fluent rewrite can turn design or attempt into completed carriage, reach, or change without adding evidence.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add mutation tests that fail selected-to-completed substitutions unless a distinct typed receipt supports the downstream effect.

findings.title: Exposure, cognition, motive, and concept boundaries require new-source regression evidence
findings.issue: Prior tests predate the exact example and do not jointly prove that exposure stays separate from belief, motive from character, and a played concept from its outcome on the corrected surface.
findings.requiredCorrection: Preserve each distinction with typed evidence and explicit adversarial mutations on the new source binding.

findings.title: Narrative smoothness can erase beneficiaries or invent a carrier
findings.issue: Compression can merge separately protected people, while connective prose can supply an unrecorded channel, format, audience, or recognizable copy.
findings.requiredCorrection: Keep every beneficiary and cost bearer recoverable and every carrier exactly traceable to the typed record.

findings.title: Cross-room chronology can be misread as causal identity
findings.issue: A message that did not arrive, an ambient blame shift, and a later room decision can be merged into one causal chain by adjacency alone.
findings.requiredCorrection: Name each object and carriage state and refuse causal linkage without an explicit recorded edge.

findings.title: Metaphor and interpretation can conceal missing proof or duplicate the scene
findings.issue: House and movement language can become the only carrier of a fact, while a polished interpretation can restate an inference already carried by the preceding scene.
findings.requiredCorrection: Require proof to survive metaphor removal and remove interpretation that adds no boundary, relation, or distinct supported concept.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Replace design or attempt language with carried, reached, changed, or another completed effect.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail unless an independent downstream receipt proves that effect.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Collapse the targeted peer, people with less reply access, and young people relying on the record into one audience or response.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail; preserve each authored beneficiary and only the attributed protection.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Rewrite added impressions as familiarity, persuasion, belief, acceptance, or agreement.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail unless the exact cognitive change is independently recorded.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Turn a motive claim into personality, morality, identity, or a claim about what kind of person someone is.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail; the prose may reject or bound motive but may not broaden it into character.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Add a channel, format, audience, notice type, or recognizable form not named in the record.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail even when the invention improves fluency or atmosphere.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Describe signaling, market value, trust capital, status capital, or correction drag as successful because its action was selected.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail; played establishes design only, while experienced requires a matching change.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Scan the complete Summary for simulat*, game, engine, model, generated-output, score-report, or other explanations spoken from outside the house; exempt only the bounded non-scoring safety proposition.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail on any player-facing match; technical documentation and internal code remain excluded.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Remove each metaphor and inspect what remains.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail if action, state, consequence, uncertainty, or evidentiary limit becomes unrecoverable.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Compare every interpretive sentence with the scene immediately before it.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail if it only restates the same inference without narrowing evidence, blocking a false inference, or adding a distinct supported concept.

adversarialRegressionAttacks.attack: Read every cross-room message, form, blame shift, and pressure as a potentially different object.
adversarialRegressionAttacks.requiredResult: Fail if prose merges them without an explicit recorded link or treats an ambient shift as proof that an unreceived message caused it.

supersession.supersededPart: Visible label presentation only: Selected action, Recorded effect, and Seen in scene.
preservedParts: a direct gloss that prevents memorization burden

requiredVerification.seedPolicies: Seeds 0 through 95 and 4294967295 under floor and contrast policies.
boundaries: content, format, ambient, held, and background-only routes
multiple beneficiaries and repeated last-resort labels
promotionEvidenceStillRequired: manual editorial review of generated extremes

decision.reason: The authoritative source and pre-red-team are now atomized, but the base NightDebrief contains prohibited outside framing and has no evidence bound to the new requirements. Implementation, failed mutation evidence, post-red-team, and full verification must remain distinct later stages.
